thread:
Mia Chen (CS): quick heads-up — Hummingbird Legal's EU demo is blocked. Their corporate proxy NATs outbound to a couple small CIDR ranges. They asked for an allowlist + temporary throughput increase. Renewal in 9 days, so this is high priority.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): please paste exact cidrs and desired qps/duration. any residency pin needed?
Mia Chen (CS): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/29. Want region pinned to eu-west-1. Increase from 20 → 80 QPS for 72h around the partner demo. Data residency requirement: keep customer data in EU (using Private routing).
Asha Patel (Onboard): context: they hit our default burst protection earlier, causing the demo to fail. Customer is anxious — if demo fails again renewal risk rises. Can we set autorevoke after 72h and a 24h reminder?
Karl Ng (NetEng): We can add those prefixes to the edge allowlist and pin routing to eu-west-1. Low-risk change, no maint window required. I'll tag the rules with an expiry and `autorevoke:true`.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): FYI we'll also prefer local KV cache and set project routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 so control-plane callbacks don't stray.
Mia Chen (CS): Suggested ops payload (expiry RFC3339):
```
allowlist:
  - cidr: "203.0.113.0/28"
    note: "hummingbird-legal demo temp"
  - cidr: "198.51.100.32/29"
    note: "hummingbird-legal demo temp"
allowlist_expires: "2026-03-25T18:30:00Z"
rate_limits:
  project_id: "hummingbird-legal-prod"
  qps: "80"
  duration: "72h"
region_pin: "eu-west-1"
soft_limit: "120"
```
Asha Patel (Onboard): please add an autorevoke job and a slack reminder 24h before expiry. tag CRM as "escalation-mitigated" if demo succeeds.
Karl Ng (NetEng): creating firewall change now. tagging with `autorevoke:true` and expiry timestamp. will smoke test from EU edge after apply.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-4521 created — "Hummingbird Legal: EU allowlist + 72h throughput". Assignees: Karl Ng, Jorge Alvarez. ETA ~15m.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): set a soft safety throttle at 120 QPS (not enforced unless infra constrained). Autoscaler will handle compute.
Karl Ng (NetEng): applied changes and smoke-tested (simulated source IP from both CIDRs). Firewall logs show accepted. Revocation job scheduled. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: CS-4521 updated: status -> done. Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z.
Asha Patel (Onboard): customer confirmed demo success and reported acceptable latency. Marked as "escalation mitigated" in CRM.
Mia Chen (CS): excellent — renewal risk reduced. I'll follow up with a short post-demo survey to capture feedback on latency and regional behavior. :thumbsup:
